030/**
031 * A validation result handler that collects the resulting findings for later
032 * retrieval using the {@link #getFindings()} method.
033 * <p>
034 * This class is thread-safe and can be used with parallel constraint
035 * validation.
036 */
037@SuppressWarnings("PMD.CouplingBetweenObjects")
038public class FindingCollectingConstraintValidationHandler
039    extends AbstractConstraintValidationHandler
040    implements IValidationResult {
041  private static final Logger LOGGER = LogManager.getLogger(FindingCollectingConstraintValidationHandler.class);
042  @NonNull
043  private final Queue<ConstraintValidationFinding> findings = new ConcurrentLinkedQueue<>();
044  @NonNull
045  private final AtomicReference<Level> highestLevel = new AtomicReference<>(IConstraint.Level.INFORMATIONAL);
046
047  @Override
048  @NonNull
049  public List<ConstraintValidationFinding> getFindings() {
050    // Sort by document location for consistent CLI output
051    return findings.stream()
052        .sorted(Comparator.comparing(f -> f.getTarget().getMetapath()))
053        .collect(Collectors.toUnmodifiableList());
054  }
055
056  @Override
057  @NonNull
058  public Level getHighestSeverity() {
059    return highestLevel.get();
060  }
061
062  /**
063   * Add a finding to the collection of findings maintained by this instance.
064   *
065   * @param finding
066   *          the finding to add
067   */
068  protected void addFinding(@NonNull ConstraintValidationFinding finding) {
069    findings.add(finding);
070
071    Level severity = finding.getSeverity();
072    highestLevel.updateAndGet(current -> severity.ordinal() > current.ordinal() ? severity : current);
073  }
074
075  @NonNull
076  private static Kind toKind(@NonNull Level level) {
077    Kind retval = null;
078    switch (level) {
079    case CRITICAL:
080    case ERROR:
081      retval = Kind.FAIL;
082      break;
083    case INFORMATIONAL:
084    case DEBUG:
085    case NONE:
086      retval = Kind.INFORMATIONAL;
087      break;
088    case WARNING:
089      retval = Kind.PASS;
090      break;
091    }
092    assert retval != null : String.format("Unsupported level '%s'.", level);
093
094    return retval;
095  }
096
097  @Override
098  public void handleCardinalityMinimumViolation(
099      @NonNull ICardinalityConstraint constraint,
100      @NonNull INodeItem target,
101      @NonNull ISequence<? extends INodeItem> testedItems,
102      @NonNull DynamicContext dynamicContext) throws ConstraintValidationException {
103    addFinding(ConstraintValidationFinding.builder(constraint, target)
104        .severity(constraint.getLevel())
105        .kind(toKind(constraint.getLevel()))
106        .target(target)
107        .subjects(testedItems)
108        .message(newCardinalityMinimumViolationMessage(constraint, target, testedItems, dynamicContext))
109        .build());
110  }

236  @Override
237  public void handleAllowedValuesViolation(
238      @NonNull List<IAllowedValuesConstraint> failedConstraints,
239      @NonNull INodeItem target,
240      @NonNull DynamicContext dynamicContext) {
241    Level maxLevel = ObjectUtils.notNull(failedConstraints.stream()
242        .map(IAllowedValuesConstraint::getLevel)
243        .reduce(Level.NONE, (l1, l2) -> l1.ordinal() >= l2.ordinal() ? l1 : l2));
244
245    addFinding(ConstraintValidationFinding.builder(failedConstraints, target)
246        .severity(maxLevel)
247        .kind(toKind(maxLevel))
248        .target(target)
249        .message(newAllowedValuesViolationMessage(failedConstraints, target))
250        .build());
251  }

263        .build());
264  }

296  @Override
297  public void handlePass(
298      @NonNull IConstraint constraint,
299      @NonNull INodeItem node,
300      @NonNull INodeItem target,
301      @NonNull DynamicContext dynamicContext) {
302    addFinding(ConstraintValidationFinding.builder(constraint, node)
303        .kind(Kind.PASS)
304        .severity(Level.NONE)
305        .target(target)
306        .build());
307  }
308
309  @Override
310  public void handleError(
311      @NonNull IConstraint constraint,
312      @NonNull INodeItem node,
313      @NonNull String message,
314      @NonNull Throwable exception,
315      @NonNull DynamicContext dynamicContext) {
316    LOGGER.atError().withThrowable(exception).log(message);
317    addFinding(ConstraintValidationFinding.builder(constraint, node)
318        .kind(Kind.FAIL)
319        .severity(Level.CRITICAL)
320        .target(node)
321        .message(message)
322        .cause(exception)
323        .build());
324  }
